entries.target:
第三课：打破宿命
%d/2 打破宿命已使用

entries.source: Grung story does not end yet, find more food and bring it here.
entries.target: 格朗格的故事还没有结束，收集更多的食物并带到这里来吧。

entries.source: Grung story ends there, he manages to gather enough food to survive some more days.
entries.target: 格朗格的故事结束了，他成功收集到了足够的食物，可以存活几天。

entries.source: #CRIMSON#You hear a terrible shriek, followed by the rustling of pen and papers.
entries.target: #CRIMSON#你听到一声可怕的尖叫，接着是钢笔和纸的沙沙声。

entries.source:
You can not comprehend what you're seeing.
#{bold}##CRIMSON#These beings would squash you like a bug if you even tried to interfere in their combat.#{normal}#
entries.target:
你无法理解你看到了什么。
#{bold}##CRIMSON#哪怕你只是试图干涉他们的战斗，这些东西也会像捏死虫子一样把你捏碎。#{normal}#
格朗格激怒了伟大的存在！

entries.source: Kill the wabbit, kill the wabbit, kill the wabbbbbiiiiiit.
entries.target: 快去打小白兔，哼哼哈嘿；快去打小白兔，哼哼哈嘿；吾辈就是要去，打小白兔……

entries.source:
It's a cold night and you did not find anything to eat during the day. Your fur pelt doesn't do much to keep the cold out either. You're about to go out to hunt, but everyone else has warned you that you must not do that. The night is dangerous and there appears to be strange lights in the sky. An ill omen, to say the least. Food has been hard to come by lately, so everyone is just as famished as you are.

The many tentacled ones who sometimes come down from the sky to look at you say that they are going to battle with themselves. You did not really understand why they would fight among themselves, even as it tried to explain it to you. You reconsider the idea of going outside when its warnings come across your mind, but the rumbling in your belly renews your resolve. Everyone in your tribe tonight must eat, no matter what.
entries.target:
这是一个寒冷的夜晚，白天你没有找到任何可以果腹的东西，你的皮毛也不足以御寒。于是你决定外出狩猎，但其他人都警告你不要这样做。夜晚很危险，而且天空也闪烁着诡异的光芒，如此不祥的预兆。但近来食物已经越来越难得，每个人都和你一样饥饿。

那些长着许多触手的存在有时会从天而降看你；它说它们将要彼此交战。即使它试着向你解释，你也不太明白它们为什么要自相残杀。它的警告浮现在你脑海中，让你重新考虑是否该出去，但肚子里的隆隆声又坚定了你的决心。不管怎样，今晚你们部落的每个人都必须吃上东西。

entries.source: Why is there a dead tentacled one here?
entries.target: 为什么这里有一只死掉的触手怪？

entries.source: Corpses are raining from the sky...
entries.target: 大量的尸体在从天上掉下来…

entries.source: The many tentacled ones are piling on the ground, forming mass graves.
entries.target: 许多触手怪的尸体堆积在地上，形成了万人坑。

entries.source: Your primitive mind recoils in horror from the thing in front of you.
entries.target: 面对眼前之物，你原始的心智在恐惧中退缩。

entries.source: Why are they killing each other? For what reason does this horror have to happen?
entries.target: 他们为什么要互相残杀？为什么会发生这种恐怖的事？

entries.source: You have fought against other tribes before, but the bloodshed you saw then is nothing compared to this.
entries.target: 你们从前也曾与别的部落争战，但那时见过的流血与眼前相比，根本算不得什么。

entries.source: You do not have the words you need to articulate your horror.
entries.target: 你无法用语言表达你的恐惧。

entries.source: Are the many tentacled ones using these creatures against each another?
entries.target: 那些触手怪物是不是在用这些生物互相攻击？

entries.source: Little of what you're seeing makes sense to you. You simply don't have the words to articulate the terror you're feeling.
entries.target: 你所看到的一切都无法理解。你根本无法用语言表达你所感受到的恐惧。

entries.source: Great blasts of light come from the sky.
Indescribable things are emerging from the darkness.
entries.target: 无法形容的东西正在从黑暗中浮现。

entries.source: Looking up, you see something writhing between the stars. You look away before curiosity gets the better of you.
entries.target: 抬头一看，你看到星星间有东西在扭动。趁好奇心尚未占据上风，你移开了目光。

entries.source: The lights nearly blind you as cascades of swirling colours explode in the darkness above your head.
entries.target: 当漩涡般的色彩在你头顶的黑暗中爆发时，强光几乎使你失明。

entries.source: Terrified by the carnage around it, the rabbit has become easy prey.
entries.target: 兔子被周围的大屠杀吓坏了，成了容易被捕食的猎物。

entries.source: A good little meal, but you will need more than this.
entries.target: 一顿美餐，但你还需要更多。

entries.source: Meat has been a rare treat as of late.
entries.target: 近来，肉可是难得的美味。

entries.source: You can leave items here for safekeeping.
entries.target: 你可以把物品安全地留在这里。

entries.source: Use the torture tools on yourself?
entries.target: 使用酷刑工具折磨自己吗？
